details.text: Isolated severe storms capable of damaging wind gusts and marginally severe hail appear possible this afternoon into evening. A watch is currently not expected

details.label: Discussion
details.text: Ahead of a vigorous vorticity maximum centered over the Champlain Valley, visible satellite imagery indicates deepening cumulus across the discussion area amidst a warming and destabilizing air mass with around 500 J/kg of MLCAPE. Eventual thunderstorm development is expected later this afternoon as height falls/cooling aloft overspread the warming boundary layer, contributing to further air mass destabilization. The kinematic environment features strong mid/upper-level winds, resulting in long, straight hodographs supportive of splitting supercells with an associated hail risk. Isolated damaging wind gusts also appear possible owing to the steepening low-level lapse rates across the region, which will enhance evaporative cooling in the sub-cloud layer

details.label: Summary
details.text: Isolated occurrences of damaging wind gusts are possible with thunderstorms developing across the region this afternoon. A watch is unlikely due to the expected limited coverage of the threat

details.label: Discussion
details.text: Visible satellite and lightning data indicate a gradually deepening cumulus field and incipient thunderstorm development ahead of a quasi-stationary boundary draped across the region and along evolving sea breeze boundaries. The 12Z observed soundings across the region sampled a very moist boundary layer, contributing to a strongly unstable air mass for elevated parcels. Since those observations, surface temperatures have warmed into the lower 90s with steepening low-level lapse rates and MLCAPE of 2000-3000 J/kg. Generally weak vertical shear and the absence of appreciable large-scale forcing for ascent are expected to limit the potential for an organized thunderstorm complex to evolve. However, the degree of instability will support vigorous pulse storms capable of locally damaging wind gusts through the remainder of the afternoon
